decision: Confirm N321 for both named Study6 Hypothesis2 mediation analyses. Sample policy excludes incomplete/unconsented cases and explicitly analyses all remaining full completers; Study6 Tables1/2 contain N168+153=321 and both petition outcomes cover these participants. The model paragraphs name audit-justification and willingness-to-sign outcomes through perceived corruption, with no additional mediation-specific exclusions. Counts refer to people, not mediator paths, repeated petition items, binary outcome categories or original Study6 N97. No inference from df or numerical model matching; no narrative verdict or ES changes.
